messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — Q3 roadmap recalibration needed. We have a pile of customer-driven asks + platform bets. Need quick alignment on RICE weights and sequencing by EOD Friday. High-level list: predictive cache, KMS integration, dedicated autoscale, latency SLOs, streaming UX polish, private deploy compliance. Any red flags?

jay: I think we should avoid wholesale reweighting. The core question: do we favor reach (PLG growth) or impact (enterprise retention) this quarter?

kevin: Reach metric is noisy for infra work. Suggest we normalize Reach to ARR bucket for enterprise features. Otherwise infra gets unfairly low score.

maria: Proposal: keep base RICE but change Confidence to be more conservative for unknowns (use half-confidence for new infra). Also add sequencing multiplier for dependency chains (0.8-1.2).

maria: RICE = Reach * Impact * Confidence / Effort

maria: quick examples (rounded):
- Predictive cache: R=30, I=6, C=0.7, E=3 => (30*6*0.7)/3 = 42
- KMS: R=8, I=9, C=0.6, E=5 => (8*9*0.6)/5 = 8.64
- Dedicated autoscale: R=20, I=7, C=0.5, E=6 => ~11.67

sachin: That makes sense. But sequencing matters: if KMS blocks private deploys (high enterprise value), we should up-weight its effective priority when it unlocks other items. I like maria's sequencing multiplier.

zach: For tie-breakers, prefer customer-SLA-impact then internal risk. So if two items are within 10% of each other, pick the one that reduces SLA exposure.

jay: Also we need clear launch criteria per initiative. Example for predictive cache: canary with no regression in p95 latency (> +10% is fail), and a 5% or better cost reduction on target workload.

kevin: For KMS: launch criteria = KMS integrated + E2E encryption test suite passing + audit log available for two customers.

product-bot: Reminder: added spreadsheet scaffold for re-scoring — https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-example (please add scores in the "Q3 RICE" tab). :zap:

maya: Okay action items:
- Everyone: fill in R/I/C/E for the items you own by EOD Thursday.
- kevin: owner for predictive cache re-score
- maria: owner for KMS scoring and sequencing notes
- jay/sachin: help validate Reach normalization for infra features

maria: One more idea — keep an "execution risk" note per row (1-5) to surface technical debt or unknown infra work. Not for math, but to inform PM judgement.

kevin: +1. Also recommend adding a short customer-impact blurb (1 sentence) so reviewers can make fast calls.

zach: If we still have ties after tie-breakers, default to the lowest engineering lead risk (who can parallelize).

maya: Sounds good. If folks agree, I'll run a 30-min sync Friday to finalize ordering and call the canary owners. :calendar:

jay: Agree. Filling scores now.

sachin: Filled my rows. Noting that dedicated autoscale needs a spike to validate scaling behavior — effort might be higher.

maria: Done. I added sequencing notes for KMS -> private deploys.

maya: Thanks team — we'll aim to freeze sequence by next Monday. :thumbsup:
